records.name: Q Bulletin
records.publisher: Institute for Health Systems Research, Ministry of Health Malaysia
records.scope_notes: Narrow fit for reports of existing completed healthcare service-process QA/QI projects using the journal's accepted methodology. Projects must have finished within five years and include at least two improvement cycles. Generic simulations, unimplemented proposals, evidence syntheses, and observational analyses without the required project cycles are not established fits. OSRI's route would concern existing nonclinical service-improvement work.

route.conditions: The Ministry of Health funds the journal; its policy excludes submission, processing, and publication fees. Article eligibility is limited to qualifying completed QA/QI projects. English manuscripts follow the journal template and stated length limits.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated under the explicit free-for-authors policy; no membership payment is specified.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific policy explicitly excludes submission fees, APCs, and publication fees and identifies Ministry of Health funding.

difficulty.basis: No acceptance statistics assessed; the completed-project restriction is a scope requirement, not an acceptance probability.

records.name: Journal of Health Management (Malaysia)
records.publisher: Institute for Health Management, National Institutes of Health, Ministry of Health Malaysia
records.scope_notes: Fits nonclinical research on service delivery, facility management, leadership, governance, policy, planning, and workforce. Accepts conceptual/theoretical papers and narrative, scoping, and systematic reviews as well as original research. Existing-data analyses and synthesis should address health-management questions. This Malaysian institutional journal is distinct from the Sage journal with a similar name.

route.conditions: Journal-specific policy covers manuscript submission, processing, and publication without fees or APCs. Instructions require British English and provide a manuscript template. Applicable ethics approval and Malaysian research registration must be reported where required.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated under the explicit no-fees policy; no paid membership or affiliation is specified.

fee_evidence.note: Explicitly excludes fees for submission, processing, and publication and states there are no APCs; articles are free for authors and readers.

difficulty.basis: No acceptance statistics assessed. Its peer-review procedure does not establish acceptance odds.

records.name: Bulletin of the World Health Organization
records.scope_notes: Fits rigorous health-policy, operational, implementation, and health-system research with international public-health significance, especially for lower-income settings. Systematic reviews and policy analyses are accepted. A purely local operational description needs broader relevance. Primary research requires an author affiliated with an institution in the study country.

route.conditions: No author fees. English submissions; research and systematic reviews normally have 3,000-word limits. Reviews require protocol registration, multilingual searching, and a search within six months. The retrieved guidelines restrict prior publication and mention a preprint exception for an international public-health emergency; check this before depositing a preprint.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No author fees; authors handle any permissions needed for third-party copyrighted material.

fee_evidence.note: Official journal homepage excludes processing charges associated with both submission and publication.
Contributor guidelines independently state that the journal charges no author fees.

difficulty.basis: Editorial criteria require international relevance, originality, and rigor; no acceptance-rate evidence collected in this role.

records.name: Pan American Journal of Public Health / Revista Panamericana de Salud Pública
records.scope_notes: Fits original and analytical research on health policy, workforce, research methodology, systems, and services with relevance to the Americas. Accepts reviews, special reports, and opinion/analysis. Suitable existing-data and synthesis projects must serve its regional public-health mission; noncritical descriptive reviews and clinical case reports are excluded.

route.conditions: Official About page identifies diamond open access without fees for researchers or readers. Accepts English, Portuguese, and Spanish. No selective waiver or membership requirement is involved in the stated free route.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None under the explicit no-fees-for-researchers policy; authors remain responsible for permissions for any copyrighted material they choose to reuse.

fee_evidence.note: Full official page read through a direct HTTPS request after the web tool returned 403. Its Access and distribution section expressly describes diamond open access with no fees for researchers or readers, as well as publication without cost to authors.

difficulty.basis: No acceptance statistics assessed; regional relevance and peer review do not establish acceptance probability.

notes: Four additional institutional/intergovernmental diamond journals; no record duplicates the ten discovery names read on 2026-11-16. No preprint or repository route was added.

Q Bulletin has a material scope restriction: completed QA/QI projects, at least two improvement cycles, completed within five years. Its fee-free status does not make generic modeling or synthesis eligible.

Journal of Health Management (Malaysia), published by the Ministry of Health's Institute for Health Management, is distinct from the Sage journal of similar name. The country label in the directory name disambiguates it.

WHO Bulletin and the PAHO journal are public-health journals retained for their explicit policy and health-systems remit. International or Americas relevance is necessary; neither is a generic informatics/software outlet.

WHO's retrieved HTML guidelines restrict previously published material and state a limited preprint exception for a public-health emergency of international concern. Do not automatically pair this journal with a preprint route.

The web tool returned 403 for PAHO pages and its PDF. Ordinary direct HTTPS requests returned 200 for the official About and author-instructions pages, which were read as full HTML. The fee evidence is therefore page-level, not a search snippet. The PDF was retrieved but not parsed and is not relied on.
No fee waiver, institutional agreement, or paid optional open-access route is represented as diamond. No acceptance rates, citation metrics, or difficulty rankings are asserted.

The review is a source-grounded venue catalog for nonclinical health-system research using existing data, synthesis, or methods. It is not manuscript-specific matching or human scientific review. Fee policies should be rechecked before submission.
